positions.as_written: Place the posterior root by its neighbours: anterior to the posterior cruciate attachment, lateral to the medial meniscal posterior root, and immediately medial to the lateral articular margin.
Place the anterior root by its neighbours: lateral and anterior to the anterior cruciate footprint, with overlap of fibres between the two.
Protect the anterior root during tibial tunnel drilling.
Make lateral posterior root inspection part of every cruciate reconstruction, before the graft is passed while access is still good.
Where the anterior root has been partly detached by a tunnel, recognise and repair it at the time.
In combined injury, plan the order so that root fixation is not compromised by the tunnel and the tunnel is not compromised by the fixation.
- A tunnel damaged anterior root must be repaired at the time or not at all.
